subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and hosting profiles

question: Should OpenClaw extend its existing fixed readiness contract with all four hosting profiles, operator-composed profiles, and the public plugin readiness callback API?
rationale: Implementation quality cannot settle permanent availability policy, three operator-selection surfaces, new response fields, and an executable external plugin contract while the dedicated RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve a narrower first release
options.body: Add canonical projection and the ready CLI over existing readiness first, deferring hosting profiles and plugin callbacks to separately approved follow-ups.

options.title: Approve the full contract
options.body: Adopt all proposed surfaces after both defects are fixed and fresh-install plus upgrade behavior is proven on a rebased head.

options.title: Keep the current contract
options.body: Decline the new permanent surfaces and retain deployer-owned supplemental checks around existing readiness.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrower first release
recommendation.body: Add canonical projection and the ready CLI over existing readiness first, deferring hosting profiles and plugin callbacks to separately approved follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The dominant merged history across the affected Gateway, plugin, and configuration contract surfaces makes this person the best available decision owner.
